recommendation: Keep the audit commit. If ODH/PHIN VADS terminology needs maintenance, perform it in the active ODH implementation guide or other external source of truth rather than in retired core OccupationalData remnants.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive STU3 change request to update OccupationalData value sets to align with new value sets that would be published in CDC PHIN VADS.
initial_application: No FHIR-14858-keyed commit was found. Nearby historical source work, especially 14a1c912d1adba5d60d633d95c0e88eacbe74b11, added PHIN VADS-backed code systems and revised ODH value-set references; the remaining inactive value-set XML still carries CDC PHIN VADS metadata and PHIN VADS contact URLs.
additional_context: Later Published/Persuasive issues FHIR-16930 and FHIR-14868 withdrew OccupationalData as a FHIR core resource. The historical removal commit efef182022eba3d6868acbe3fda5360783848135 removed ODH from active build mappings, and the combined branch already includes 9ee22091b6346c46d4c6d948113f496a86ad1a52 for FHIR-16930 removing a stale Resource Guide row. Current fhir.ini has only a commented dropped-resource note, source/occupationaldata.html is absent, and community discussion says the resource was retired/replaced by Observation profiles and the ODH IG.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo/out-of-build audit commit. No source files were changed because editing retired source/occupationaldata value-set remnants would not affect the current FHIR core specification.

related_jiras.note: Later Published/Persuasive decision to withdraw OccupationalData as a core resource; it controls current build scope and is already represented on the combined branch.
